title: On a curve, the torsion-sheaf and the Z/n-module notions of constructibility agree
statement: Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field, $C$ a separated scheme of finite type over $k$ with $\dim C\le1$, $n\ge1$ an integer and $F$ an abelian sheaf on $C_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] with $n\cdot\mathrm{id}_F=0$. Then $F$ is torsion [def-weil-pbc-torsion-etale-sheaf], so $(C,F)$ is a curve coefficient pair [def-weil-pbc-curve-setting], and $F$ carries exactly one structure of sheaf of $(\mathbf Z/n)_C$-modules [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] extending its abelian structure. Moreover the following are equivalent, and the same finite partitions and immersions serve for both: (i) $F$ is constructible in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-constructible-torsion]: there are a finite partition $C=\coprod_kC_k$ into pairwise disjoint locally closed constructible subsets [def-weil-constructible-subset] and immersions $\iota_k:Z_k\to C$ with image $C_k$ such that each abelian inverse image $\iota_k^{-1}F$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] is locally constant as an abelian sheaf [def-constructible-locally-constant] (an etale covering $\{U_i\to Z_k\}$ and abelian groups $A_i$ with $(\iota_k^{-1}F)|_{U_i}\cong\underline{A_i}$ as abelian sheaves) and has finite stalks at all geometric points [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]; (ii) $F$, with this module structure, is a constructible sheaf of $\mathbf Z/n$-modules in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf] with $\Lambda=\mathbf Z/n$ (on each stratum the module inverse image is locally isomorphic to constant sheaves of $(\mathbf Z/n)$-modules $\underline{M_i}$ with $M_i$ finite). (Ingredients: a constant abelian sheaf $\underline A$ on a nonempty $U$ with $n\underline A=0$ has $nA=0$, $A$ being its stalk at a geometric point, and is then the underlying abelian sheaf of the constant sheaf of the $\mathbf Z/n$-module $A$; an abelian-sheaf isomorphism between sheaves of $\mathbf Z/n$-modules is $\mathbf Z/n$-linear; both notions use finite partitions into locally closed constructible pieces with immersions. The hypotheses on $C$ and $k$ only serve to make $(C,F)$ a curve coefficient pair; the equivalence holds on any scheme.)

source.place: Definition 03RW (definition-constructible), parts (2) and (3), compared for Lambda = Z/n, with Lemma 095E (lemma-constructible-quasi-compact-quasi-separated); Definition 03RU (definition-finite-locally-constant). Not stated in Stacks, which passes between abelian sheaves killed by n and sheaves of Z/n-modules silently (proof of Theorem 03SC). Agent-formulated.

proof.text: Evaluate n times the identity at each object and section. Every section is annihilated by n>0, hence the sheaf is locally torsion. Apply isTorsionAbelianSheaf_characterizations. Use the existing ModuleCat-valued lift exists_module_sheaf_of_nsmul_id_eq_zero, not the SheafOfModules-valued interface.

Prove fullness of forgetting cyclic modules directly: every residue scalar of ULift(ZMod n) is the cast of an integer (ZMod.intCast_surjective), and additive maps respect integer multiplication (Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul and map_zsmul). Faithfulness is inherited. Thus sheafCompose is fully faithful. Lift e followed by eN inverse with Functor.preimageIso and cancel eN to establish existence and uniqueness.

Construct both underlying-sheaf pullback isomorphisms by leftKanExtensionCompIsoOfPreserves and sheafComposeNatIso. The comma categories are filtered by structuredArrowOpEquivalence. Forgetting preserves filtered colimits. For module-to-abelian forgetting, prove preservation of sheafification from W_iff_isLocallyBijective: the equalizer and image sieves are the same on underlying sections. Transport finite local constancy and finite stalks along these isomorphisms.

On each fixed stratum apply finite_local_abelian_forget_iff to the abelian inverse image. Apply finite_local_cyclic_module_forget_iff to the module inverse image and identify its underlying abelian sheaf by the preceding step and the chosen lift isomorphism. forall_congr gives both requested equivalences for the given stratification.

Unfold both constructibility definitions. Convert the Stratification witness to LocallyClosedStratification and conversely by retaining the same underlying Topology.Stratification, domains, immersions, immersion instances and image equalities. Constructibility of each part is already a field of the topological stratification. Apply the pointwise comparison to every part to prove both directions.

split_report.summary: Read def-weil-pbc-constructible-torsion (imported: finite partition into locally closed constructible subschemes, restriction locally constant with finite stalks) and def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf (stratification with constructible strata, module inverse image finite locally constant with finite values, Stacks 03RU) exactly, and the two users: lem-weil-pbc-curve-constructible-sub-quotient steps 3 and 6 use (i)=>(ii) and (ii)=>(i) with n=N; prop-weil-pbc-algebraically-closed-extension step 10 (with lem-weil-pbc-curve-constructible-reduction, whose hypothesis is module-constructibility for F_r) needs (ii)=>(i) with n=r prime (C_red proper of dim <=1). Statement made exact: the abelian reading of 'locally constant' (def-constructible-locally-constant with abelian coefficients, as in the sub-quotient lemma step 1), finite geometric stalks, same partitions for both; noted that the curve hypotheses only make (C,F) a curve coefficient pair. Proof in six steps: torsion + unique Z/n-module structure + full faithfulness (new node lem-weil-pbc-sheaves-killed-by-n-zmod-modules, unsplit, agent-formulated), partitions agree (both require constructible locally closed strata with immersions; no Noetherian argument needed), module inverse image vs abelian inverse image (prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact (2)), constant pieces on nonempty U (stalk = value, so finite stalks = finite values and nA=0; constant module sheaf has underlying constant abelian sheaf, Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-constant-module-sheaf-underlying), the two directions. Mathlib: no locally constant or constructible sheaves on sites; Sheaf.IsConstant and Sheaf.isConstant_iff_forget recorded. Source repository: IsConstructibleSheaf (WeilConjectures/ConstructibleSheaf/Defs.lean:249) is generic in an abelian concrete coefficient category A and is applied only with A = ModuleCat Lambda; no comparison lemma between AddCommGrp and ModuleCat (ZMod n) exists; IsConstructibleSheaf, IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf, IsLocallyConstantSheaf reach no sorry.

reviewed.note: Six steps: torsion and the unique Z/n-structure (new node lem-weil-pbc-sheaves-killed-by-n-zmod-modules, agent-formulated, unsplit); the partitions coincide (elementary); restriction commutes with forgetting (prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact (2),(3)); constant pieces (constant-sheaf stalk, finite values = finite stalks on nonempty pieces, lem-weil-pbc-constant-module-sheaf-underlying); the two implications, with empty pieces discarded. Statement fixed to the abelian reading of 'locally constant' in def-weil-pbc-constructible-torsion (imported, ambiguous) and tightened to the two definitions' exact clauses. The hypotheses on k and C are only for the curve coefficient pair. The known-defect pointer of prop-weil-pbc-algebraically-closed-extension step 10 is now set (this node added to its step 10 uses).

lean.statement: theorem constructible_torsion_modules_agree {k : Type v} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {C : Scheme.{v}} (f : C ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsCurve f] (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (F : Sheaf C.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}) (hF : n • 𝟙 F = 0) : letI : NeZero n := ⟨Nat.ne_of_gt hn⟩ let R := ULift.{v + 1} (ZMod n) let U := sheafCompose C.smallEtaleTopology (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{v + 1} R) AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}) ∃ hT : C.IsTorsionAbelianSheaf F, let P : CurveCoefficientPair k := ⟨C, f, inferInstance, F, hT⟩ ∃ (M : Sheaf C.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{v + 1} R)) (e : U.obj M ≅ F), (∀ (N : Sheaf C.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{v + 1} R)) (eN : U.obj N ≅ F), ∃! a : M ≅ N, U.mapIso a ≪≫ eN = e) ∧ (P.IsConstructible ↔ IsConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf M) ∧ ∀ S : Stratification C, ((∀ i : Fin S.n, IsFiniteLocallyConstantEtaleSheafOfSets ((etaleSetPullback (S.immersion i)).obj ((sheafCompose C.smallEtaleTopology (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})).obj F))) ↔ ∀ i : Fin S.n, let G := (Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (S.immersion i)).obj F IsLocallyConstantSheaf G ∧ ∀ (Ω : Type v) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S.domain i), Finite (((pointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber (A := AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})).obj G)) ∧ ((∀ i : Fin S.n, let G := (Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (S.immersion i)).obj F IsLocallyConstantSheaf G ∧ ∀ (Ω : Type v) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S.domain i), Finite (((pointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber (A := AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})).obj G)) ↔ ∀ i : Fin S.n, let G := (Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{v + 1} R) (S.immersion i)).obj M ∃ d : LocallyConstantDatum G, ∀ j : d.cover.I₀, ∃ A : ModuleCat.{v + 1} R, Finite A ∧ Nonempty ((G.over (d.cover.etalePrecoverageToEtale j)) ≅ (constantSheaf ((S.domain i).smallEtaleTopology.over (d.cover.etalePrecoverageToEtale j)) (ModuleCat.{v + 1} R)).obj A))
